bdug pa dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs gzi chen tshong dpon bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od rab dpal de la/ /na bza'i bla re ①dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tshangs pa bag chos mkhan gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ston pa bla ma la/ /sha kha ra yi ri ②yu phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'od dpag med pa gla mi'i⑧tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa bkod pa'i 'od de la/ /gdugs gcig cig ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa klu sbyin phreng7rgyud tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng go⑧rnam bsgyings la/ /me tog dag gi chun po phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs brtan gshegs nor bu mkhan gyur tshe/ /de bzhinasregashegs pa yid gnyis spong de la/ /rin po che yi dra ba phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs don yod mthong ba nad pa'i gsos sman la/ /sbyor mkhan579bur gyur tshe na dge slong dge 'dun dag /spyan drangs nad sman sbyar nas bde gshegs legs mthong la/ /dang po kho nar byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs brtson 'grus sbyin pa 'khor los sgyur〈rgyal tshe/ /tsan dan dmar po dag las gtsug lag khang brgya stong ske/ /byas te ras bcos g.yogs nas de bzhin gshegs pa po/ /bdud rtsi'i stabasashel dang por byang chub tu ni 0sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs bzang skyong gis ni bde gshegs zla ba'i 'od/ /nyan thos bcas pa'i dge 'dun 'khor bcas7)khri phrag bcu/ /zhag bdun bar du zhal zas ro ni brgya ldan pas/ /45—671

tshim par mdzad de dang por byang chub tu ni nyu)sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dga' bo rtsal chen bram ze'i bur/ /gyur tshe de bzhin gshegs pa mchogashegrags la / /yu ba nor bus spras pa'i rnga yab gcig /phul nas dang por byang chub sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'chi med rgyal po yi/ /pho nyar gyur tshe bde gshegs dbang sbas la/ /pan tsa li yi 'bras bu phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng ge'i rgyal mtshan zhing pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nga ro gsal de la/ /skyu ru ra yi 'bras bu phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba tshal gyi52las byed tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thogs med 'khor lo la/ /a ru ra yi 'bras bu phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos ldan dpa' bo'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi'i nga ro la/ /rgyal mtshan dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mchog dga' rgyal po spos 'tshong tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes mchod rten la/ /phye ma spar gang phul te gtor nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu nir+sāsems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs kha lo sgyurarnyub byis pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul la/ /pa la ba ta gsum zhig phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dga' gshegs rgyal po'i bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rgyal po la/ /dngul gyi me tog dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chu lha tshong pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kha dog dpag med la/ /lhung bzed sbrang rtsis bkang ste phul nas 45—672

kyang | /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan lag ni rtse ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stobs chen de la ni/ /'chag sa khru brgyad khor yug bkram nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs spos glang spos 'tshong7bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bkod pa rnam grolasagyi/ /'chag sa spos kyi chu yis chag chag btab/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rnam gzigs gos 'tshongasagyur pa'i tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa gzigs pa sgrib med la/ /me tog gi ni gdugs dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'brug sgra rdza mkhan gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i stabasasnyide la/ /spos dang ril ba gcig cig phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs legs sems khye'u lo gsum lon pa'i tsherjo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu rnam gzigs la/ /pad ma dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yid bzang tshong dpon bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtsal sbyinam de la ni/ /sna ma'i me tog phrengasheb phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs dri med tha ga par gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs mthong de la ni/ / 'ba' sha gshegacig dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs zla ba glang chen 'dul ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs bzang de la ni/ /me tog phrengamatshab khru gang phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs grags chen grong khyer rten hu1pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros grags de la/ /me 45—673

tog dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs gtsug na nor bu khye'u yi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen bkod de la/ /sa rdul spar gang dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa drag shul lha'i bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spa hu/ba'i 'od de la/ /lha yi gzhal med khang gcig phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng stabs gdugs mkhan gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thar par bzhud de la/ /tsha ba'i dus tshe lo ma'i gdugs phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ljon pa phyugs rdzi'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan bkod de la/ /lam gyi shing drung dag tu be'u ras phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rnam rgyal ba lang rdzi yi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nges pa'i blo de la/ /lhung bzed 'o mas bkang ste phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs shes rab brtsegs pa dge slong tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes tog de la/ /nyin gcig rangs par chos kyi gdan phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs legs gnas lham mkhan gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo'i blo de la/ /mchil lham rim pa gcig pa phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros las byed tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spyod pa'i blo gros la/ /ro dang ldan pa'i btung ba phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yan lag skyes ni mi 'dzin tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs bzang de la ni/ /45—674

khrus ras dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo mtha' yas pa ni/ /lam ston gyur tshe bde gshegs bden smra0)la/ /shing drung gnas mal dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugasasho bzang sde dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skad dbyangs de la ni/ /me tog ud pal lnga zhig phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mkhyen ldan dgon⑧gnas dge slong tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs par mthong de yi/ /'chag sa༄byi dor dag ni phul 'tsho/nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'od zer shing rta mkhan gyur tshe//de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid mtha' yas la/ /nyal khri stong ri ba dag 3)phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brtul zhugs brtan pa ni/ /phreng〈rgyud mkhan tshe bde gshegs yid 'ong sems//de la me tog bla resaphul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bkra shis shing thun tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa'i shing rta la/ /bu yug langs tshe snang ma bltam 1)nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bden tog khrus pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan me tog la/ /kha gdong bkru ba dbul ba byas nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs pad ma tshong dpon bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog 'od zer la/ /pad ma dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sred med bu ni spos 'tshong nyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gdul 45—675

bar dka' zhes bya ba de'i/ /khang pa brtsegs pa tsan dan dmar pos byugs7nas kyang / /dang po kho narakhubyang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lag bzangs rgyal po'i pho nya'i7tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs snyan sgrogasam④par mdzad pa gang / /'khor bcas bye ba dag la chos gos gsum phul nas/ /dang po kho narashebyang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'byung gnas ni/ /tshan7po cher gyur g.yul ngor chasalgepa'i tshe / /bde gshegs legs mthong la ni rgyal mtshan gcig /phul nas dang porasabyang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 'phro sman pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skye bo'i mchod rten la/ /spos kyi reng7bu dag ni phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs byin lam ston tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od chen zhes bya ba/ /de la lam dag mtshon pa byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen 'byung gnas mnyan pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brdzi ba med gshegs de/ /nyan thos 'khor bcas bye ba bsgral nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs lha yi me tog nor bu mkhan//gyur tshe de bzhin gshegs pa blo gsal la/ /nor bu rin chen spras pa'i gdugs phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs don legs sems pa rgyal bu'i hunyetshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsung snyan de la ni/ /nor bu rin chen spras pa'i bla re 8phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs chos kyi dbang phyug shing mkhan gyi/ /bur gyur tshe na bde gshegs skar 'od kyi/ /gshegs zamatshwanyedag ni bsham pa byas nas kyang / /45—676

dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs blo grags kun dga' ra srungs7tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i sgron de la/ /mon sran gre'u yi me tog phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs spobs( )brtsegs tshong pa'i bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes tog de la/ /sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pas spyan drangs nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje'i rgyal mtshan ni/ /tshal7gyi las byed tshe na de bzhin gshegs/ /bsod nams bkod de la ni a mra phul / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phan bzhed grong dpon bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams 'od ces bya ba las/ /nyin gcig srog gcod spong ba'i bslab gzhi mnos nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rnam rol grong rdalasabyis pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'byung gnas la/ /lhung bzed sbrang rtsis bkang ste phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mun dang bral ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa srid mtha' gzigs de la/ /mon sran gre'u 'bru mar me bzhag phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs sgra gcan lha ni grong rten tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dga' bar gzigs de la/ /ha sta ba sha ka dag phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs ri bo'i rgyal mtshan tshogs ldan gyi/ / khye 'ur gyur tshe〈bde gshegs mtha' yas 'od/ /de la me tog chun po phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tshogs can 'od ni phrengalorgyud tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yid 'ong 45—677

dbyangs de la/ /me tog las byas bla ro①phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen snying po khrus pa'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa sna tshogs gsung ba ②la/ /kha gdong bkru ba dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs shin tu mthor gshegs grong khyer rten⑧pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshul khrims stabs bde grong khyer du/ /gshegs pa'i tshe na gdan dag bshams te btings④nas kyang / /dang po kho nar7byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs skar rgyal da nur mkhan gyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor lha de la/ /zhal zas bca' ba rnams ni phul nas kyang0)/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs ru rings shegazhan gyi khol gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid dga' de la/ /lhung bzed 'jams ④kyis bkang ste phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan grags pa bsod snyoms tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer mtha' yas la/ /gos kyi ras ma sor bzhi tsam phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed dol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zlas bde gshegs srid sbyin de/ /'khor 7bcas bye ba sum cu dag la gtsug lag khang / /bzang por longs spyod phyir dang dpag tshad bcu pa'i gos/ / gding ba 37phul nas dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs nyi 'od gzhan gyi khol gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lhun po che de la/ /lcags tu kyi snod dag dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs skar mkhan tshong pa'i bur gyur tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs gsal de la ni/ /nor bu rin chen dpag 45—678

tshad gcig 'od ldan/ /phul nas dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng tog ded dpon gyi/ /bur gyur tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa po/ /blo gros bzang la phreng7ba phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal po ni/ /snyan dngagasalgemakhan tshe bde gshegs tsam mchog la/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi snying po yis/ /gzhan gyisadage 'dun bshos gsol yi rangasnyinas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bkod pa chen po la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs srid mtha' gzigs pa tshal dag gi / /las byed tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa po/ /khyad par sems la chab gtsang phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs glog 'od rngon pa'i bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bo'i sems de la//rtswa yi stan dag dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bdeshegashegs seng ges53)byin pa khyim bdag gi/ /bur gyur tshe na bde gshegs pad snying la/ /sna ma'i me tog yod pa'i sa gzhi 0phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs gzhan gyis mi thub rgyal mtshan gyis / /'jigs bcas lam du 'dron7pa'i bsel byas nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sredatswamed bu de la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mchog dga' grags pa bu ram shing / /'tshir rmo/nyagyur tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa po/ /blo rnam tsho/ge'abyed la bu ram bcud khu phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs brtson 'grus brtan pa bram ze'i 45wa 679

bur① / /gyur tshe bde gshegs 'od zer mtha' yas la/ /khrus rkyen 'dagashepa'i tshal57dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs grags rdzogs chang 'tshongarababur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'isnying ro la/ /lo ma'i snod nas chu dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs bsnyengs bral rgyal po'i bur gyur tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal po'i9)nga ro la/ /lo ma'i snod nas bar sha'i me tog phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mchod 'os lha ni blon mchog gyur pa'i tshe/ /bde gshegs yid 'ong blo 'od dag la dpag tshad gcig /khor yug tsam gyi skyedasngoshemos tshal phul a ga ru'i/ /bdug pas bdugasashete dang poratshwakye byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs sgron chen mi bkren gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams 'od de la//rtswa yi sgron ma dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do//bde gshegs 'jig rten 'od ni lha'i bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i 'od de la/ /me tog man rā〈nyar ba'i gdugs phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs spos dri zhim pa gyad gyur7tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yan lag mdzes de la/ /khrus ras dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan mchog 'dzin sman pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtog pa med don la/ /bdug pa dang ni dar hunyeyug phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mun dad rnam bral rgyal po yi/ /mdun 'don bur gyur tshe na de bzhin gshegs/ /dgra bcom gzi la mu tig rgyan phreng phul/ /45—680

dang por7byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i⑧'gram pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don grub blo de la/ /'dam rdzob dag tu shing zam btsugs7phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen grags pa spos 'tshong gi/ /bur gyur tshe na bde gshegs dbyangs mnga' la/ /phye ma spar gang dag ni gtor phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs skyon rab zhi ba rgyal bu'i tshe/ /gsadakyibya btson dag 'bros su btang nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa sa mchog de la ni/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs bdud rtsi 'chang ba grong dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od 'bar de la ni/ /be+e drur+ya0yi gdugs stong phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mi zla phrengasargyud mkhan bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nges par sems de la/ /ud pa la yi phreng ba phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shin tu gzigs pa gi⑨/ /'dun dpon tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa po/ /bden par gsung ba de la phreng ba phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rab brgyan grong khyer la rten〈skrepa'i/ /bur gyur tshe na bde gshegs mdangs 'od kyi/ /grong khyer sgo dag mdzes par byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs nor 'od brgya byin gyur pa'i tshe/ /bde gshegs gzi brjid me tog rgyas pa la/ /dpag tshad khor yug me tog char phab nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis/ /bde gshegs grags tog shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gsung7tshe 45—681

legs gsungs zhes ni yi rang0)phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni〈sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs don nges ldan pa tha ga par/ /gyur tshe bde gshegs yon tan gsal ba la/ /ras kyi kha tshar dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tshems sbyin blosachen bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi sgron de la/ /bsil yabarabadag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen 'byung gnas gzhu mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsal rab dpal de la / /me tog snyim pasnyibakang ste gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs skye dbang mtshungs pa rdza mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zhal sdug sde bdag la/ /snod dag chu57yis bkang ste phul nas kyang //dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs stabasashegashegs zhing pa'i bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i stabs bzhud la/ /zam stegs dag ni gzugs pa byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs blo gnas shing srungs bur gyur du)tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skye bo'i mchod rten la/ /se'ushe'abru dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang //dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs gdugs mdzes blon po'i bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho'i blo de la/ /tsam pa'i me tog phreng hu chib phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gtso bo gser mgar tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i snying po la/ /bdug pas bdugs pa'i 11me tog gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs shin tu 'phags dpal spos 'tshong〈she45—682

bur / /gyur tshe de bzhin gshegs pa0)gdugs sde yi/ /'chag sa spos chus chag5michag btab nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng ge'i sgra ni rnga mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sā7la'i rgyal po la//rnga bo che dag brdung ba ④byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs rnam rol ldan pa dung 'bud mkhan/ /gyur tshe bde gshegs nyi ma'i snying po de/ /grong khyer gshegs tshe dung dag bus nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// //'phags pa bskal pa bzang po pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po nyi shasnyibazhi pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa klu 'od zla ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub dga' de la/ /rnga bo che dag brdung ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs me tog ri bo gar mkhan bur/ /gyur tshe bde gshegs dbang po zhi de yog/ /spyan sngar byoshegar dag gis mchod nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs klu'udaga' gar mkhan bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i 'od de la/ /rol mo'i57skra dag bsgrags pa byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs spos kyi dbang phyug rgyal po yi/ /sras mor gyur tshe de bzhin gshegs pa po/ /pad dkar spos la mu tig rgyan phrengarwa )phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs shin tu grags pa tshong dpon gyi/ /chung mar gyur tshe de bzhin gshegs pa po/ /lhun po'i 'od zer spyi bor bla re (1phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs stobs lha grong khyer rten tu pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i zhal de la/ /45—683

bshos dron lhung bzed bkang ste phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan phreng7ldan gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsgyings ldan bzhud de la/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal thal mo lan gsum sbyar/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa klu lag grong khyer gyi/ /sgo srungs7tshe na phyag dar byas nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs rnams lta de la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mig brgyanas rgyal bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi 'od de la/ /chu dang skyu ru ra dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tshul khrims gsal de snga dro zhig④ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs par sbyangs pa'i blos/ /dga' bas sangs rgyas rjes su dran byas nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zil gnon ye shes kyis/ /ngan 'gror 'gro ba tshul khrims la bkod nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas blo de la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs mtha' yas spyan ni gos 'tshongasatshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas gzugs de la/ /ras bcos bla ro57dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegaso bden gsung khyim bdag bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus brtan de la/ /me tog dag las byas pa'i gdugs phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs nyi 'od bca' ba mkhan bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha yis mchod de la/ /la du dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed7do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa des blo bzo mkhan7tshe/ /de 45—684

bzhin gshegs pa kun nas blo de la/ /gding ba dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mtha' yas gzugs ni shing rta mkhan/ /gyur tshe de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zhi la/ /pa0)la shi ka dag ni phulakunas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rnam par snang mdzad khar ba mkhan/ /gyur tshe bde gshegs mi yi gzi byin la/ /me long gcig cig dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen tog nisnyenor bu mkhan gyur tshe/ / de bzhinashegashegs pa bsod nams stegs bzang la/ /nor bu dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs the tsom spangs pa rgyal po yinya/ /btsun mor gyur tshe bde gshegs brtson brtan la/ /me tog skyed mos tshal dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'jig rten 'das pa ma7mi khar / /gyur tshe bde gshegs thub par grags de la/ /dbu zhu gcig cig dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs don yod rnam gnon mi mjed bdag /tshangs tshe bde gshegs grags ga⑧rgyal mtshan la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtogasam1)par mdzad pa pos/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom 'od de la/ /spos kyi ri lu dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs me tog rgyal mtshan rgyal bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas gsal de la/ /rtswa yis bkab pa'i khang bzangs phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni 45wa 685

sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs ri dbang rgyal po 'dregatumakhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid che de yi/ /dbu skra legs par breg pa byas nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs gzi brjid chen po 'bru mar mkhan/ /gyur tshe bde gshegs dgra bcom mchod 'os kyi/ /gtsug lag khang du spos bsgos 'bru mar phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs don mdzad gzigs pa tal ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi mchog de la/ /lhang tsher leb leb po dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bdesnyegashegs grags pa mtha' yas 'khor los sgyur rgyalasatshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don grub sems dpa' de la ni / / 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i⑧gser gyi gdugs stong phul nas kyang / /dang po nyid du7byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen lha ni 'dzam gling gi/ /rgyal por gyur tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dga'as9)mchod la/ /'bras bu'i skyed5nyemos tshal dag dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang po nyid du7byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don gnas mkhyen pa chang 'tshong gi/ /bur gyur tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu sbed/ /srang du gshegs tshe thal mo sbyar te phyag byas nas/ /dang po nyid dus(1byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo rdzogs rgyal bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu dang ba tsho/rtel/ /me tog dag las byas pa'i gdugs phul nas//dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mya ngan med pa dpa' bo'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros sems pa de/ /'jigs pa med pa'i tshul gyis spyan drangs nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de 45—686

bzhin gshegs pa dri ma bral ba yis/ /sems can kun la yud tsam byams bsgoms nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nges byung7blo de la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs lha shing srungasar+sā)tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lhun po'i dbyangs de la/ /bu ram shing gi sdong busaphul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sa yi dbang phyug ni/ /dge slong gyur tshe de bzhin gshegs pa po/ /sna tshogs gsung ba'i chos gdan bting nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs me tog spyan ni rgyal po yi/ /mir gyur tshe na bde gshegs 'brug sgra la / /ud pal dmar po dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rnam 'byes sku ni btso blag mkhan/ /gyur tshe bde gshegs 'od chen phung po yi/ /na bza' dag ni bkru bshal byas nas kyang //dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos 'od kyis ni grong dag dang / /yul 'khor rnams su pha rol phyin drug sgra bsgrags nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal ni brtsegs pa de la yang / /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs kun gzigs stobs kyisnyi'akhor losalgesgyur ba'i tshe/ /gtsug⑧lag khang mchog bye ba drug cu byed bcug munas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med par dga' de la/ /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed dokhye/ /bde gshegs yon tan 'od gsal phyag dar par/ /gyur tshe bde gshegs yul 'khor lha de la/ /rdo leb gdan dag dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla zhal bram ze'i bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge dga' ba'i 45—687

dbyangs de la/ /kun ta ra yi me tog dag ni gtor nas kyang / /dang po7nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen 'od ni ded dpon tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mtha' yas de la/ /rin po che yi sgron ma phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen tog ni lcags mgar tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mthong na dga' de la/ /ljagasaltebazhar dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa grags bla chang tshongasatshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgron ma'i rgyal po la/ / 'dzam bu'iphur bro ba dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'od byed tshong dpon bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi tog de la/ /mu shi gag sha'i me tog gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs gzi brjid dpag yemed phreng pergyud tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs su rnam grags la/ /pad ma 'dabarkubargya pa dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen gos 'tshongashetshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa spyan sdug de la ni/ /ras yug dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng ge'i sku ni spos 'tshong 8tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i tog de la/ /spos kyi phur ma dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mkhas blo tshong5)dpon khol po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs med sbyin de la/ /me tog chun po dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal dka' lha'i〈nyebu'i 45—688

tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyu skar rgyal po la/ /me tog man 'onyer ba phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan phung po ni/ /sngalashechen lta bu'i bram ze'ishebur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba lha de la/ /phreng7phul dang por byang chubashesems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla tog spos 'tshong0tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i 'od de yi/ /khang pa brtsegs par spos byug phyir phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mthu thob shing srungs7tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa che de la/ /dgun7shing dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mthu rtsal mtha' yas tshong dpon gyi/ /bu tshe de bzhin gshegs pa 'jam dbyangs la/ /se 'bru dag ni〈nyedabul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs zla ba bram ze'i bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ston par dgyes de la/ /ud pal chang pa gang zhig phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dri med tshong dpon gyi/ /bu tshe de bzhin gshegs pa grags bla8la/ /me tog bar shig skye ba'i sa gzhisaphul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs don kun gzigs pa ded dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi rgyal po la/ /mu tig dag gi phreng ba phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bo spos 'tshong7tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dmar ser 'od de la/ /tsan dan dag gi gdan khri phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'byor ldan tshong 'dus pa yi tshe/ /45—689

de bzhin gshegs pa bde bar 'dudaponade la/ /snyun rkyen gsos sman mar dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs bsod lanams ba lang rdzi yi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros sems de la/ /snod dag zho yis bkang ste phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs sgron ma tshal gyilo )las byed tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbyig gsal de la ni/ /a mra'i rtsona'abras bu dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'od 'phro ni/ /ro bro 'tshong55)tshe de bzhin gshegs pa po/ /skyon zhi de la kha ra'i dum bu phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo yangs kun rgyu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyu skar rgyal po la/ /lo ma dag gi ri lur0phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs legs skyes rgya mtsho'i52tshong pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsnyengs dang ri bral de la/ /nas1)bza' stong phrag brgya ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nor lha shing 'tshong 0tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gsal de la ni/ /rtswa 31bam sgron me dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yid gnyis spong ba gser mgar tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa yid gnyis sel mdzad la/ /gser gyi me tog dag ni 12gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'dzin pa dpag med gser rtog kyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa'i dpal de la/ /gser ni spar gang gtor te phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchog srid gesde dpon 45wa 690

gyi / /bu tshe de bzhin gshegs pa gtso mchog la/ /gser las byas pa'i gdugs dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa choms med lcags mgar7tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sna tshogs gsung de la/ /a ha tan ka dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mi gnas grong khyer rten⑧pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gzigs de la/ /me tog rangs pa dag ni phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa der gnas thags mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba gzigs de la/ / sku regasasredag ni dbul ba byas nas kyangapon/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tshogs chen gtso bo mgon med bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud zil gnon pa de la ni/ /mon sranapo)gre'u yi 'bru mar mar me phul nas kyang / /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'gro ba'i 'od zer 'khor los sgyur laba'i tshe/ /bde gshegs shing rta chen po 'khor bcas bye stong la/ /rgyal po'i zhal zas dag ni brim pa byas nas kyang ske/ /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phal chen 'khor los sgyur5geba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i stobs〈)kyis gshegs de la/ /dpag tshad bcu gnyis khyon tsam skyed hūṃ )mos tshal phul nas / /dang po hunyenyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rgyal ni 'bru mar mkhan gyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer tshim de la/ /zhabs bsku ba dag dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid mtha' yas khrus pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin 45—691

gshegs pa kun tu sbed pa de la ni/ /'dag pa'i chal gyis7snod dag bkang ste phul nas kyang / /dang posanyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs don gyi blo gros nad pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don grub mthu rtsal la / /kha ra'i dum bu dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs sman pa'i rgyal po phye 'tshongs tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i 'od de la/ /phye yi bsod snyoms dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tha ba spangs pa sman pa'i tshe/ /dge 'dun dag la mar khu phul nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa gzigs pa'i phung po la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rims med shing bzo byamakhan gyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag blo de la/ /shing rta dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por0)byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /de bzhin gshegs pa legs byin bram ze'i bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshogasam ༄can mya ngan 'das pa na/ /mar me'i phreng ba dngar7ba stong snyed phul nas kyang / /dang po7nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa grags byin grong khyer mchod rten la/ /rten pa'i tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa nor bu gsal/ /grong khyer dag tu gshegs kur〈nyeme tog gtor nas kyang / /dang po5)nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog byin pa ni/ /nor bu mkhan tshe de bzhin gshegs pa po//yon tan 'od la nor bu'i bla resaphul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs skyes bus 8byin pa thags mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i sgron de la/ /ras kyi 8kha tshar dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang 45—692

chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje'inyesde ni phreng〈rgyud kyi//bu mor gyur tshe bde gshegs 'byor ldan 'od zer la/ /me tog mya ngan 'tshangakyidag dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang posnyinyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs phalasachen byin ni gar mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ston par dgyes de la/ /tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis bstod nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs zhi7ba'i blo gros rgyal po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs par don sems la/ /bar shi me tog dri ldan gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spos glang gdugs mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gzigs de la/ /gro ba dag las byas pa'i gdugs phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sred57med bu ni khyim bdag tshe/ /'brog dgon dag tu dge slong dge 'dun btung chu phul/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i rgyal mtshan de la ni/ /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa des pa dman las byed bu'i〈tshe/ /bslab pa'i gzhi lnga dag las gzung7ba byas nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa mnyam par gnas pa de la ni/ /dang po nyid du7 byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mi tshugs nad pa mgon med bor ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mthu rtsal chen po de yi lam/ /lag mthil〈nyetsam zhig phyag dar legs par byas nas kyang / /dang po nyid du〈nyebyang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi zla gi tam tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhas mchog pad spyan hu la/ /dbyar gnas dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /45—693

de bzhin gshegs pa glog tog rgya mtsho'i tshong pa'i tshe/ /khutubargyad kyis bskorasaspug las byas pa'i gdugs phul nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i 'od zer de la ni/ /dang posanyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa las byed tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsal ba mtha' yas la / /lasasnyibatang byas pas rnyed pa phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal sbasasnyishing srungs7tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas gzugs de la/ /a mra dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs ye shes nyi ma rdza mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi gdugs de la/ /lhung bzed dang ni gun 47phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don grub sman pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od zer la/ /spos kyi reng bu dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lhun brtsegs〈khral mi'i tshe bde gshegs yul 'khor kha lo sgyur tso)de la/ /lhags pa'i dus su shing khur gcig phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra nyu1'dul ya nga ba'i/ /dpyad mkhan tshe na bde gshegs legs mthong dag /'brog dgon bzhugs tshe lhang tsher gdugs phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma phreng〈nyergyud tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bshes gnyen bzhed lha de la/ /pad ma dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom grags pa ni/ /nor bu mkhan tshe bde gshegs skal bzhed la/ /nor bu 45—694

rin chen me shel gcig phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs ye shes 'gros ni klu rgyal tshe/ /bde gshegs nyi zhalanyesos ku'i dus dag tu/ /lam du zhugs tshe char pa phab nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs nyon mongs bral ba gar mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thogs med spyan de'agel/ /me tog chun po dag ni phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'dam bu dbul po'i bur gyur tshe/ /dgon par bde gshegs seng ge'i stabs de la/ /bshos dron dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyedasado/ /bde gshegs spos bzangs bram ze'i bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgron ma che de la/ /lo ma dag las byas pa'i gdugs phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yul 'khor rangasatswani shing srungs57tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bzhinapo)par mdzad de la/ /bsil yab dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs lha grags grong khyer rten pa'i 7)tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan gsal de la/ /sosheras na bza' dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs srid mtha' gzigs pa lam ston tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams snying po yi/ /lam srang dag ni mtshon pa byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba spos 'tshong7tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos de 'chag pa'i tshe / /dus kyi rjes 'brang spos ni zho gcig phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra gcanarwalhalas mi'itshwa tshe/ /de bzhin 45—695

gshegs pa lha dga' de la ni/ /phyag 'kharashegacig cig dbul ba byas nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ / bde gshegs7rin chen zla ba rgyal bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsnyengs med dgyes de la/ /ta la pa ta dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng ge'i rgyal mtshan rdza mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab rgyal mtshan la/ /sum pa ka yi lhung bzed phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs bsam gtan dgyes pa grong khyer gyi/ /pho nya'i7tshe na bde gshegs mdangs 'od la/ /me tog chun po dag ni phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdzogs ldan rngon pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zlas byin de la ni/ /mig mi 'dzumasalgepar blta bsnyebyas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam rol rgyal bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan dbyig de la/ /dpag tshad khor yug me tog chal bkram phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan rin chen ljongs gtso'i tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas 'od de la/ /me tog tsam pa ka dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dgra bcom grags pa mnyan pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa des pa po de ni/ /gru dag gis ni bsgral ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs pad ngos 'bru mar mkhan gyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa grags pa'i tog de la/ /dri zhim zhabs bsku bsredag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mdzod spu ldan pa tshong pa'i 45—696

tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa bsnyengs7med nga ro la/ /lhung bzed zho yis bkang ste phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs spos grags tshong pa'i khol po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu yon tan la/ /lan tshwa srang 'ga'7zhig ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje nor bu yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'bar ba'i tog de la/ /tshod sngon chang pa gang zhig bsod snyoms phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tshe dpag med ni sman pa'i tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa sred med bu de la/ /mig sman ri lushedag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs nor bu bkod pa khye 'u'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen gsal ba yi/ /lam srang dag tu me tog dkar po phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang chen gyad kyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu dgongs de la/ /ko dra ba yi 'bru dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan 'byung gnas bram ze'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs sems de la ni/ /ril pa gcig cig dbul ba byas nas kyang //dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lhun po grags pa yisaX/ /phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun dag la rdzing phul nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros bzang po la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer bcu pa lha〈bu'i tshe/ /bde gshegs gzi brjid mtha' yas byang chub snying por ni/ /snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe na sor mo lnga bsregasakyinas/ /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde 45—697

gshegs ma smad shing rta mkhan gyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i phyag de la//lo ma dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs glang po'i 'gros ni grong khyer du/ /rtenatupa'i tshe na bde gshegs blo snang la/ /sha ma ka dag dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yid 'thad gnag lhas srungaskruba'i tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi rgyal po la/ /dar ba dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen zla ba lam ston tshe/ /bde gshegs bden pa'i tog gi lam dag tu/ /gos kyi gdan dag gding ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /de bzhin gshegs pa zhim ba sman pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs par gnas de la/ /ud pa la yi bkru sman phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rab gsal rgyal po spong brtson pa'isnyu / /dge slong tshe na bde gshegs dpag med pa'i/ /lha la a yo ga⑧dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs kha lo sgyur ba ded dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'phags pa'i me tog la/ /tsan dan dmar po'i khang bzangs phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegasar ridaga' ba'i dbang phyug phyug po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod sbyin chen po la/ /rol mo'i sgra yis mchod pa byas nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs gtsug na rin chen rtsis pa yirimu/ /khye'u tshe de bzhin gshegs pa tog chen la/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i phye ma gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /45—698

de bzhin gshegs pa bsnyengs0)bral rtswa 'tshong70tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i 'od de la/ /ka pidasngo ta yi phur ma phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs sgra gcan⑧lha ni shing 'tshongasatshe de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od de la/ /r+sā56)las byas pa'i mchil lham7phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs na tshod bzang po grong srungs nitshe/ /grong khyer dag gi sgo ni phye nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa rma bya'i nga ro la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha dga' sman pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu rnam rgyal la/ /shi ri sha yi me tog gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen phung po smad 'tshong7ma'i/ /gtso mo'i tshe na bde gshegs 'byor 'od la/ /na ba ma la'i me tog gtoralonas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mdzes gshegs tshong dpon bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ni mtha' yas la/ /ud pa la ni gcig cig phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs seng phyogs btso 3)blag mkhan gyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snyan par dgyes de yi/ /na bza' bkru bshal dag ni byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs shin tu mthor0gegashegs glang po che'i/ /rdzi'i7tshe de bzhin gshegs pa bde gshegs kyi/ /gdan ni 'ba' ti shing drung bting munas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs skye dbang grong khyer rten nyu tshopa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsal ba'i lha de la/ /tre ka ni yi 32me tog phul nas kyang / /dang por byang 45wa 699

chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs blo gros bzang po grong dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas gshegs de la/ /a mra'i lcag ma dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'jig rten 'od ni spos 'tshong7tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor lha de la/ /spos rnams dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen gzi brjid bram ze'i tshel/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo zab de la ni/ /bal dang 'bras bu dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang porasnyebyang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs skal ldan shing rta rtswa 'tshong tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sde yi 'gros de la/ /me tog chun po dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs kun rgyal 'khrul 'khor mkhan gyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i 'od de la/ /dar gyi lda ldi dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do//bde gshegs dga' ba bkod pa tshong dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid phung po la/ /'o mar bcas pa'i 'bras can phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stegs ni mdzad pa po / /shing rta mkhan tshe bde gshegs dgyes chung la/ /shing las byas pa'i mchil lham phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs spos kyi glang po khyim bdag tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mthu rtsal chen po la/ /rma bya'i bsil yab dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs blo gros 'od 'phro rgyal po yi/ /btsun mo'i tshe na bde gshegs rgyal sdesal/ /me tog par shi chang pa gang phul nas/ /45—700

dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs ri bo7rgyal mtshan khye 'u'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don grub gshegs de la/ /lag pa 'dag pa'i chal dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spos bzangs tshong dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba sdug de la/ /me tog chun po dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs chos brtan nor bu mkhan gyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i nga ro la/ /rin po che yi gdugs dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs gzi brjid drag shul gser mgar tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ston pa gsal de la/ /gser gyi me tog dag ni gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs chos kyi nor bu ded dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes phung po la/ /mu tig dmar po dag ni gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs bzang byin grong khyer rten⑧pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid me tog la/ /bshos dron bsod snyoms dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs zla ba phrengasargyud mkhan gyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid phung po la/ /ud pal lnga zhigasregator ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs tshangs dbyangs lag⑧bla byed pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdzu 'phrul 'od de la/ /tshems shing dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng ge'i zla ba rgyal po yi/ /pho nya byed tshe bde gshegs gzi mtha' yas/ /de la mchil lham dag ni dbul 45—701

byas nas①/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed medo/ /bde gshegs dpal ni tshong dpon bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer mtha' yas la / /gser gyi phrengs ba dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs skyes gser mgar tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi snying po la/ /rin po che yi sdong busaphul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs thub med tshogs ni 'dunasnyedapon bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad grags pa la/ /sbrang shirtsir byasalgepa'i 'o ma dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang po nyid dukhubyang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs grags pa'i bshes gnyen7tshong dpon gyi/ /bur gyur tshe na bde gshegs bden tog la/ /me tog dag gi phreng ba phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bden pa phreng71rgyud tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid drag shul la / /me tog chang pa gang zhig phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dka' thub chen po tshong dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i tog nyurtede la/ /'khor rnams thams cad dbul ba byas nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs lhun po'i 'od zer 'khor sgyur nyi)rgyal po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lhun po chen po de la ni / /rin chen yu bar bcas pa'i gdugs 'bum phul nas kyang / /dang po nyid duchabyang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan brtsegs pa ded dpon bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa bkod 8pa de la ni/ /rin chen snam bu 9lda ldi dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang po nyid dus byang chub 45—702

tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mchod grags sngal7chen lta bu'i bram zesatshe / /'khor ni bye bar bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa po/ /'jig rten rnam par grags la khrus kyi yo byad phul/ /dang po nyid du7byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos grags lam ston tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa drag shul byin pa yi/ /'chag sa dag ni phyag dar byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sbyin 'od dpa' bo'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchog tu grags de la/ /rgyal mtshan dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa glog 'byin grong dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don grub mthu rtsal la/ /gding ba dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bden gsung khyim bdag tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha yisasnyemachod de la/ /sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i 'bras chan phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'tsho byed lha ris pa yi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bden pa po de yi/ /gtsug lag khang ni phyag dar byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs na tshod bzang po rtswa 'tshong7tshe/ /bde gshegs zil gyis mi non grags pa la/ /rtswa yi sgron ma dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs legs pa'i tshogs can 'khor sgyuralo)tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom 'od de la/ /na bza' rin po che dag phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rnam nges blo gros tshong dpon gyi/ /bu tshe de bzhin gshegs pa sgron chen la/ /mu ka tsan tra 45—703

ka dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa srid mtha' nor bu'i spos/ /rim gro pa tshe bde gshegs blo spyod la/ /chos kyi gdan dag bshamanyepa byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rgyal bas dgyes pa gos 'tshongakhutshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mthu rtsal can de la/ /chos gos gsum dag dbul ba byas nas kyang //dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng ge'i 'od zer lam ston tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thogs med gshegasalgepa po/ /lam du zhugs tshe bskor ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do//bde gshegs rnam par snang mdzad rin po che/ /rtog shes tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa po/ /yid gnyis spong ba'i 'chag sa bshams nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa grags mchog spos 'tshong tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brtul zhugs che desnyel/ /sna ma'i me tog chun po phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ / thobade gshegs thugs rab gzhungs pa phyag dar ba'i/ /bu tshe de bzhin gshegs pa lha gsal la/ /mngon sumashedag tu bstodamo/dī pa byas nas kyang / /dang por〈nyebyang chub tu ni sems bskyed do turte/ /bde gshegs nor bu'i zla ba lha bu'i tshe'/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'khrul med gshegs de 'kha/ /lha yi gzhal yas khang dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs drag shul 'od zer dgon pa yi/ /dge slong tshe na bde gshegs yul 'khor lha/ /de la chos gos snam sbyar phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs brtul zhugs thub78med rgyal bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs 45—704

pa mdzes par dgyes de la/ /gdugs dang dar yug dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'gros mchod gdol bu'i tshe/ /nyi ma 'ga' zhig bslab pa lnga mnos nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog dpal de la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs nor bu'i tshogs ni brgya byin tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'jigs sbyin de la/ /gser gyi shing rta rkyen bcas stong snyed phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'jigaturten bla ma bram ze'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha dga' de la ni/ /ma jikhuka yi me tog gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs glang chen seng ge long ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thar pa'i 'od de yi/ /'chag sa dag ni chag chag btab nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba rgyal po'i bur gyur tshe/ /zla ba bzhir7ni dge slong dge 'dun na ba yi/ /gsos sman dag la spyan drangs bde gshegs 'od 'phro la/ /dang po nyid du0byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen 'od zer 'khor los sgyur ba yi/ /btsun mo'i tshe na bde gshegs yon tan 'byung gnas la/ /yu ba nor bus spras pa'i rnga yab dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang po nyid dushebyang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs sgra gcan7sbed pa tshan7chen tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa'i blo de ni⑩/ /lam du zhugs tshe bsil ba'i rlung yab byas/ /dang por57byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan rgya mtsho grong rdal gyi/ /byis pa'i tshe na bde gshegs byang chub 'od/ /de la tshems shing dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni 45—705

sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'od zer ldan pa tshongashedapon gyi/ /bu tshe de bzhin gshegs pa rgya mtsho la/ /mar me'i kha ni stong snyed phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed7do/ /bde gshegs rab tu zhisastabs rgyad kyi byam/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub dgyes de la/ /nor bus spras pa'i mchil lham phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'jig rten bzang po spos 'tshongasabur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha chen de la phye ma yis⑥/ /bkang〈ba'i na bza' dang ni pad ma phul nas kyang ske/ /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mya ngan med pa gos 'tshong7khye'u yi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo ni zab mo7de la yang ske/ /rdzi char byung ba'i tshe na me tog gdugs phul nas/ /dang po 0nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed〈nyedo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shugs bcu rgyal bu'i tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbang phyug can/ /lam du zhugs tshe gdan dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs stobs dgyes hu)rol mo mkhan gyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gtso chen de la ni/ /dung sgra dag ni bud hunyepa byas nas kyang / /dang por byang 0chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mthu dpal rol mo'i glu mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros sems de las8/ /gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba mnos nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mthu thob mnyanamatshepa'i tshe/ /chu bo dag la zam pa btsugs nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'od de la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mthu chen khrus pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgongs pa 45wa 706

'khrul med la/ /khrus ras dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan snying po tshong dpon gyi/ /bu tshe bde gshegs bsod nams 'phags pa la/ /dha nu mnyera'i me tog phulasnyenas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bden spyod spos 'tshong7tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nor lha'i bu grags la/ /spos kyi ri lubodag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /de bzhin gshegs pa dge mchog rgyal posargyal po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bkod chen sangs rgyas de la sogs/ /dge slong dag gi dge 'dun spyan ni drangs nas kyang / /dang popo)nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skar rgyal shing mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i 'od ldan pa/ /bde gshegs de la thal sbyar phyag byas nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'od zer chen po tshal gyi las/ /byed tshe bde gshegs lha yikyi'od zer la/ /ljon pa'i tshon dag sbyar te phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegasalgepa glog 'od rdza mkhan tshe/ /bde gshegs 'od gsal de la zla ba bzhir⑨/ /bum pa chu yis bkang ste phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs yon tan rgyalamachen nad pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams dgyes de la/ /lcags7 kyi snod dag dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin po che ni tshong dpon gyi/ /bu tshe bde gshegs seng ge'i blo gros la/ /mu tig dag gi5nyechun phrengasaphul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin 45—707

gshegs pa dpal 'od spos 'tshong7gi/ /bu tshe de bzhin gshegs pa sa gtso la/ /phye mas bkang ba'i ud pal na bza' phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs go cha bgos pa lha'i〈bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'od de la/ /bston⑧pa dag gis bstod pa byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng ge'i phyag ni tshal gyi las / /byed tshe bde gshegs 'od zer bzang po la/ /me tog dag gi phur ma phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs me tog bzang po yig mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sna tshogs gsungasnyide la/ /gro ba'i glegs ma dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen mthon po shal khyer tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba sdug de la/ /mar me dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rgya mtsho rol mo mkhan gyi tshe/ /rnga bo che dag brdung bshebyas nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i gdugs de la//dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sa 'dzin mgar ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gzigs de la/ /mtshon cha dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs don blo lha'i bu7nyi ma'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gos pa med de la/ /me tog man drasher ba gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs yon tan bsags pa sman pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa grags bla bzhud pa na/ /'dam rdzab dag tu rdo leb zam btsugs nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan tshogs ni sman 45—708

pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i zhal de la/ /skyu ru ra yi 'bras bu gcig phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen me ni ded dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa klu yi lha de la/ / be+e drur+ya'i7snod chu yis7bkang ste phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs 'jig rten 'das pa tshong 'dusalgepa/ /byed tshe dge 'dun dag la 'od sgron phul/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan phung po la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'jig rten zla ba 'khor sgyurasnyitshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan blo de la/ /gtsug lag khang ni stong snyed phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs snyan rgyal po bram ze'i tshe'u/ /phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun dag gi bsam gtan khang brtsigs nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog mchog mapo)de la ni/ /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bdeshegashegs tshangs tog bram ze'i bu yi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dga' de la/ /ku sha'i na bza' dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyedasnyido / /bde gshegs tshogs can gtso bo bram ze'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid dpag med la/ /ril ba chu yis bkang ste phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng stabs gling gcig rgyal po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bden pa'i tog de la/ /ras bcos gding ba dpag tshad gcig pa phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs drag shul byin ni tshong dpon gyi/ /chung ma'i tshe na bde gshegs nyi 'od la / /phye ma spar gang dag 1)gis gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni 45—709

sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs chos kyi dbang phyug phreng rgyud tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi'itu'od desal/ /me tog chal par bkram pa kun phul nas / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs gzi brjid 'od ni lha'i bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ston par dgyes pa po/ /byang chub snying por bzhugs lasartswa gdan phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs 'od zer chen po khyim bdag tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsang b.rasredagyes de la/ /ras bcos bye ba snyed ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen grags pa rgyal bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbyig gi 'od zer la/ /bla re spos can dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tshogs can gsal ba rin chen 'tshong56)ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams 'byung gnas de la ni/ /rin po che dag spar ba bkang ste gtor nas kyang ske/ /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs grags pa mtha' yas ded dpon gyi/ /bu tshe bde gshegs me tog dpal de la/ /na bza' bla reshedag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs 'od zer don yod rgya mtsho'i〈nyetshong pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan phyag ldan de la ni/ /mu tig dmar po spar ba bkang ste gtor nas kyang / /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs lha yi drang srong drang srong tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyishesgron ma la//lo ma dag gi gdugs ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs skye dbang 'khor los sgyur hu7ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin 45—710

gshegs pa kun tu 'od zer la/ /gling bzhi dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dge 'dun brtan patumatha' 'khob rgyal po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs can de la ni / /me tog stong snyed bkram7pa'i 'chag sa phul nas kyang / /dang po nyid dukhubyang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa phyogs bzang gser 'tshongakhutshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pakhebakod pa chen po la/ /gser gyi glegs ma bkram pa'i 'chag sa phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tog ni gser mgar khye'u yi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thar pa'i nyi ma la / /mar me bzang po bshams te phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yul 'khor me tog rtswa 'tshongal)tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus brtan po7yi/ /'chag sa 5⑧yis khebs par bkram nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed rtso)do/ /bde gshegs chos7kyi blo gros tshong dus pa yi tshe/ /tshong dus bar srang dag ni phyag dar〈nyebyas nas kyang ske/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo yi 'od ldan de la ni/ /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rlung7shugs ltar gshegs snying tatsokhye'u yi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan grags pa de la ni/ /bsil yab dag gis g.yab pa dag ni byas nas kyang / /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs legs bsams7grags pa gtarasnyimakhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs pa'i blo de la/ /nor bu skar 'od dag ni phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs snang ldan rgyal po'i pho nya'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bkod pa dpag med la/ /lan 45—711

gsum bskoratub dag ni byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ / bde gshegs7lha tshogs 'khor sgyur blon⑧mchog tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i5gemache ba la/ /gser dang byisaru dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan bsrungs pa 'dron po'i tshe/ /lam srang dag tu rdo stegs btsugasashenas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams mthu rtsal la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs don gyi blo gros lnga mngon shes pa po/ /bram ze'i tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa lha mchog gi/ /zhabs la mgo bo dag gi7phyag dag 'tshalashenas kyang / /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs bsnyengs med chu rka srung5)ba'i tshe/ /nyin zhag bdun du byams pa bsgoms nas kyang ske/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs gnas la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa grogs brtan gos 'tshong5shetshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi mchod rten la/ /khang brtsegs mon dar dag gis bkab pa phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'od gnas mtshungs pa dge slong tshe/ /dam chos yongs su gzung phyir spro bskyed nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa glog gi 'od zer la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs nor zhabs tshong dpon bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal bar dgyes de la/ /me tog ud pal chang pa gang gtor nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs thar pa'i gzi brjid grong dpon bu mo'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lhun po'i rgyalasamatshan de la ni/ /bsod snyoms dang po dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang 45—712

po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ngos bzangs phyugasanyerdzi'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog 'od de la/ /zhun mar dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs blo bzangs phyug po'i bu tshe sangs rgyas kyi/ /dge slong kha ton⑧'don parashebaza' ba byin nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros mchog ma de la ni / /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs kun gzigs rab byung zhag bdun dge slong tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spos kyi ngad ldan bcom ldan gyis/ /legs par gsungs la rjes su yi rang phul nas kyang / /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs ye shes mchog ni dge slong tshe/ /ting 'dzin 'di la yi rang byas nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan mthu rtsal la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs gnas rgyal bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros khyad par la/ /yan lag lnga ldan sil snyan byadag gis mchod/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bden gsung khyim bdag tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa drang srong gsal de la/ /lhung bzed 'o mas bkang ste phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo bzangs sman pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen sgron de la/ /a ru ra yi 'bras bu dgu phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs stobs byin tshong dpon bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid 'bar ba yi/ /gtsug lag khang dag skyong0nul byugs nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng geshestabs ni rgya 45—713

mtsho'i tshong pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzigs pa7tha ma de la ni/ /byi'adiru spar ba bkang ste gtor ba byas nas kyang / /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs me tog tog ni rgyal rigs gzhon nu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbyig la dgyes pa de la ni/ /rin po che yi phrengaphub dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs ye shes 'byung gnas phreng91rgyud tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bkod pa mdzes de la/ /pad ma'i rdzing bu dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs me tog byin pasnyiganas rten7tshe/ /bde gshegs yon tan dpal gyi snying po yi/ /'chag sar 'ji ba'i gong bu phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan snying po drang srong tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzigs pa gsal de la/ /rgyang ma nas ni thal sbyar phyag byas te/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen grags pa shing rtog7tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mdangs stobs de la ni/ /a ti mug ta'i me tog gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs grags pa rmad byung rdza mkhan gyini/ /bu tshe bde gshegs rnam dag spyan de la/ /chu yi sbyin pa dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mi tshugs dmangs rigs khye'u yi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes brtul zhugs la/ /ba ru ra yi 'bras bu gcig phul nasal/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs bsnyengs med rgyal chen rnam thos bu yi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zhabs dag brtan pa de la ni/ /lha rdzas dag gi tsan dan dag gis gtor nas kyang / /45—714

dang po nyid du4)byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs nyi ma'i 'od ni rgyal po yi/ /mdun 'don byed tshe bde gshegs 'phags spyan⑧de/ /zhag bdun bar du gdugs tshod gsol nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tshangs rabasregashegs pa mnyan57pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thar bsnyedagyes de la/ /chu bo'i 'gram dag bstan cing mtshon nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs lha yi mthu rtsal tshong dpon tshe/ /phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun sgo gang phub ri'u)nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs chen de la ni/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs ye shes dgyes pa rdo mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor mchog de la/ /lha yi zhal zas dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha bden sman rtsa 'tshong ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs par spyod pa'i 'od de ni/ /snyun gyi gsos sman dag la rtag tu spyan drangs nas/ /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs nor bu'im snying po nya ba yi/ /khye'u tshe bde gshegs sa ri las de la/ /me tog bzhi zhig dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan grags pa dka'ashespyod tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan gsal de la/ /zhugs ling dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs ye shes dpal ni bca' ba mkhan bu'i nyu )tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad grags de la/ /lhung bzed bca' ba dag gis bkang ste phul nas kyang / /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 45—715

bcings med rten bcas gcig pu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba'i7mchog de 'kho/ /gdugs tshod gsol tekhusprang ma bskradakyinas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyedasnyido/ /bde gshegs brtul zhugs brtan pa blon chen0tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes par gzigs de la/ /khang pa dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs lha yi gzi brjid dam chos nub pa'i tshe/ /dge slong chos smra smos shig smos shig ces brjod nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba lta bur gsung de la/ /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tshangs par thub pa rgyal po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bla ma'i dbyangs de la/ /grong khyer dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dal bzhud dge slong rkyen7pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams dpal de la/ /so bi ra ku'i btung ba phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs brtul zhugs dka'a'uthub phyag dar pa yi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsdu ba mkhyen pa po de yi/ /lam srang khru bcu srid du phyag dar byas nas kyang / /dang po nyid du7byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs 'od zer phung po khyim bdag tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan gyi rgyal po de/ /'jigs pa med pas dgon par spyan drangs nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs gzi brjid chen po rgyal bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rims nad med pa yi/ /blo mnga' de la rgyan dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tsam pa ka ni rgyal phran tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'phags pa dul ba la//45—716

mu0sna ka dag dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /de bzhin gshegs pa dga' mdzad bram ze'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi lha de la/ /ril ba spyi blugs dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tshogs can bzang po lha〈bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan bdud rtsi des / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshe legs pa phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dbang po'i rgyal mtshan mchod sdong srung ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thogs pa med pa grong khyer du/ /gshegs pa'i tshe na mchod sdong dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang po nyid du7byang chub tu ni7sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes chenashesman pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi'i phung po la/ /sman gyi reng bu dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs sna ma'i⑧me tog 'od ni gar mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i 'od ldan de la ni/ /sna ma'i me tog dag gi phreng7ba phul nas kyang / /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs tshogs can7'od ni chang 'tshong〈nyetshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra de〈nyel ni/ /phye mas bsgos pa'i me tog gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do//de bzhin gshegs pa skrun mdzad shing lha'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i nyi ma la/ /me tog kur7ni ka dag gtor7nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mdangs 'gro shing rta mkhan gyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi bsnyengs thob de la/ /bzhugs khri'u dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs don 45—717

legs nges ni rdza mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhas pa dgyes de la/ /zhag gcig bzhugs pa'i gnas ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs khyu mchog blon che'i bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo mi 'khrul de la/ /seng ge'i gdan khri dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do// //'phags pa bskal7pa bzang po pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po nyi shulalnga pa/ bde gshegs lag bzangs thams cad byed pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro bsnyedaga' de la/ /gos kyi dum bu dag ni phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'od zer chen po lag bla'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi mchog de la/ /skyu ru ra dag dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs bsam pas byin ni khrus pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rdzu 'phrul mchog de la/ /phyag dag bkru ba'i chal dgasaphul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs bsod nams 'od ni dbul po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi gdugs de la/ /bshos dron bcud dang ldan pa phul nas kyang / /dang por5nyebyang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ ci/bde gshegs rin chen dbyangs ni ri mo mkhan gyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan dag ni bris nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa klu yi 'od ldan de la ni/ /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rdo rje'i7sde ni bcings pa med pa po/ /ral pa can gyi tshe na de bzhin gshegs pa po/ /mthu rtsal drag shul can la rdo leb phul nas kyang / /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems 45—718

bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'byor ldan phreng0)rgyud tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi gzi brjid la/ /tsam pa ka yi phrengasab phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng ge'i stobs ni phyag dar pa yi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa srid pa'i mtha' ni gzigs pa po/ /bcom ldan de ni phrag lasablangs te 'dam rdzab bsgral/ /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ / de bzhin gshegs pasaspyan ni 'dritumakhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa khrel yod bzang po la/ /ka la man dag dbul ba byas nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'od srungashesbyangs gnas dge slong tshe/ /bde gshegs rgya chen gzugs kyi 'chag sa dag /lhung bzed 'bru mar bkang bas chag chag btab/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gsal rgyal bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi spyan de la/ /'od zer me tog dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs ye shes 'gros ni rgya mtsho'i tshong pa'i tshe/ /nyam thag tshe na sangs rgyas dag la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /tshig tu brjod nas bde gshegs tshogs kyi 'od zer la/ /dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs gzi brjid drag shul mgar ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i mchog de la/ /dngul las byas pa'i lhung bzed phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'od zer chen po tshong dpon bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mnyam par bzhag pa'i bdag nyid de/ /nyin gcig bzhugs pa'i gnas ni byas te phul nas kyang //dang po nyid du byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs nyi 'od grong rdal 45—719

byis pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan tog de yi/ /ras kyi gdan dgashegading ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dri med 'od ni mdun 'don tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skye dbang mtshungs de la/ /mchod sbyin dag gi ra ba phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs gzi brjid rnamasa'abyis chang 'tshongakhutshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs med bshes gnyen la/ /kha ra'i btung ba dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs khengs med rtsisalgepa'i khye'u yi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsdu ba'i blo mnga' la/ /ci tse'i phub ma phrag stakyigang phul nas/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs sbrang rtsi'i zhal ni lham mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra thul de la ni/ /me tog ud pal dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs zla 'od rten bcas nad pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zam pa'i 'od de la/ /men sran gre'u rul pa dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa glog sbyin 7rgyal po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri bo brtsegs pa la/ /yid 'thad khang pa brtsegs pa phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rab zhir gshegs pa shing 'tshong tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtse gcig 'od de la/ /chu dron snod dgarwatebakang ste phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mi 'khrugs pa yisatsodage slong dag la ni/ /ji srid 'tsho bar gnod sems med par 'dzin bcug nas / /de bzhin gshegs pa sred med bu yi mthu rtsal la/ /dang po nyid du byang 45—720
