ma ṣa'ishesgron ma dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs gti mugs45)rab zadamacho 4)bya ba'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgra dbyangs mchog de la/ /sha srang gcig cig dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dpag med lha ris pa yi tshe//de bzhin gshegs pa mngon shes drug sgra la/ /tshems shing dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs zla ba bzang po dge slong tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mdangs stobs de la ni/ /gding ba dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa ④mtha' yas tog /tshong dpon bu tshe bde gshegs mi yi grangs/ /mar me'i phreng tsub dngar te phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs brtul zhugs bstar7ba tshong pa'i tshe/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i me tog tshogs de yi/ /sku la tsan dan dmar pos mebyugs nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mchod gnas lha yi rim gro pa/ /byed tshe de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug chen la/ /me tog nyis ni pa dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mya ngan rgal ba myig 9)ma mkhan/ /byed tshe bde gshegs lha yi bdag po la/ /ta la mu tig tshadag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dge dgyes 'bru mar mkhan gyi tshe/ /bde gshegs bag mi tsha bar gnas pa la/ /'bru mar srang gcig cig ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'gro ba'i blo gros 'bru mar mkhan/ /byed tshe bde gshegs dgra 45—771

bcom byang chub la/ /yungs mar srangatubargyad snyed ni7phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes gshegs rgyal bu'i tshe/ /bde gshegs mya ngan mun pa sel ba la/ /rma bya dag las byas pa'i bsil yab phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zhabs mdzes ded dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa chu bo rnam dgashel / /mu tig dag gis gtor ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ud pal brgya byin tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i 'od de la/ /sku tshe'i 'du byed gzung bar gsol btab nas//dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dul gnas me tog gser rtog tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' ba'i sems de la/ /gser dag gis ni gtor ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs spobs pa mtha' yas 'od zer pad ma mkhan/ /byed tshe de bzhin gshegs pa thar pa'i shes rab la/ /shing las byas pa'i lhung bzod dag nikyiphul nas kyang / /dang po nyid dusabyang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs drang srong gsal ba phrengasargyud tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpa' bo'i sems deshel/ /me tog dag las byas pa'i gdugs〈kyephul nasal/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan brtson 'grus khyim bdag tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tsam pa'i sgron ma la/ /'jams gang zhig ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snying po mar 'tshongam tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod gnas dpal de la/ /zhun mar srang brgyad snyed ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang 45—772

chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs lha bdag ka ran dza byed tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros legs sems la/ /bklu0)/ka dag dbul ba byas nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen mthon po rgyal bu'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzi brjid dpal de la/ /spos dang phreng ba dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsal ba mitshong pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skye bo dad pa la/ /sbrang rtsi bldag par bya ba phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa skal ldan shing rta can/ /lham mkhan tshe na bde gshegs blo mchog la/ /mchil lham dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs bsod nams blo gros phrengasargyud tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab dgyes gsal ba la/ /me tog dag gi chun po phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs sbyin sregasre'od 'phro thags53)mkhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdag nyid snang ba la/ /ras kyi kha tshar dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yon tan mtha' yas gzi brjid phung po ni / /tshong pa byed tshe bde gshegs mi yi pad ma la/ /ras yug zung du sbyar te dbul ba byas sne)nas kyang / /dang po nyid du ④byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs seng ge'i stabs ni shing srungs5nyatshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spos dri zhim pa la/ /se'u 'bru'i bcud khu dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo shing srungs0)tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa mchog de la/ /a ti byamug ta'i me tog gtor 45—773

nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rab gsal sman pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa me tog sna tshogs la/ /mar khur0)dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /bde gshegs 'od spyod khyim bdag bur gyur tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'phags pa'i dpal de la/ /phrengang ba brgyus pa dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs glu dbyangs shing rta mkhan gyi tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa namasamakha' mtshungs de la/ /gzims khri dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ / de bzhin gshegs pa glu dbyangs sman pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i 'od zer la/ /me tog sil ma dag ni gtor nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /④bde gshegs 'khor lo 'dzin pa phrengasargyud tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gsal ba'i lha de la/ /me tog sil ma dag gisapo)gtor nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dbyigatsomachog ral pa can gyi tshe/ /bde gshegs bsam gyisakemi khyab stegs de la/ /rtswa yi mal stan7dag ni phularwa sdunas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs 'jig rten dga' ba tshong dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i 'od de la/ /phreng 11ba dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs chos kyi zla ba lag bla'i tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa phung po chen po la/ /shing mchog dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mtha' yas grags pa phyugs nya rdzi yi/ /dpon po'i tshe na bde gshegs stobs chen 45—774

la / /'o ma dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sprin tog gos 'tshong0)tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yul 'khor ye shes la/ /ras yug dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs shes rab 'gros ni khyim bdag tshe/ /'khor gyi khyams dag phyag dar byas nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa drag shul blo gros la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spos bzangs dbul po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ri dbang blo de la/ /mar me'i snying po dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs nam mkha'i dbyangs7ni tshong pa'i tshe / /de bzhin gshegs pa yan lag mdzes pa la/ /na bza' phrugs gcig cig ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs lha ni lha ris pa yi tshe/ /phyag dar dag ni'u bya ba byas nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi mchog de la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs lha rgyal phyugs rdzi'i dpon po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi bshes gnyen la/ /'o ma dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs nor bu gsal ni dka' thub can/ /byed tshe bde gshegs yid gnyis spong ba po/ /de la gdugs dag dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /de bzhin gshegs pa nor bzangs spos 'tshong tshetshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom ldan de la/ / kār ṣā pa ni ⑥gcig ri'i 'bru mar dang / /spos phul dang por byang chub〈pesems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sgron ma go'u45—775

tam tshe/ /dbyar gnas pa dag dbul btubyas nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa spos kyi dpal de la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen nga rosridabyangs/ /tshong 'dusalgepa tshe bde gshegs dgra bcom gnas④/ /de la zhun mar bre gang phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs skye dbang rgyal po tshong dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan gnas de la/ /kun dga' ra ba dag ni phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs sgra gcan sbed pa shing srungs7tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus cher dgongs la/ /sge'u gsherarnyudag gi dum bu phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dge mdzad chu chun tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od ni 'bar ba la/ /chu grang dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng ge'i blo gros khyim bdag tshe//de bzhin gshegs pa mthu rtsal sdud pa la/ /me tog blta na sdug pa phul nas kyang ske/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs rin chen grags pa shing srungs7tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgongs pa zab bsgoms la/ /sgra dbyangs dag gi⑥mchod pa phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don mdzad phyug po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa spos sreg de la ni/ /rnga bo che dag brdung batshwa )byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mdzad mtha' gzigs pa khyim bdag tshe/ /gtsug lag khang dag byas te phulamanyanas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa spos kyi glang po la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /45—776

bde gshegs srid pa'i me tog khrus pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par 'byed blo la/ /khrus ras dag ni dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mdzod spu ldan pa drang srong tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros mchog de la/ /ku sha dag las byas pa'i na bza' phul//dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs spobs pa mtshungs med rgyal po ri motumakhan/ /byed tshe de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan bkod pa po/ /de la me tog dag gi phreng snob phul nas kyang / /dang po nyid dukhubyang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs ye shes rnam 'byed nga ro 'gron po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brtul zhugs seng ge de yi ni/ /lam srang dag tu gos ni gding ba byas nas kyang / /dang po nyid du⑥byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng ge'i mche ④ba dge slong tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes blo gros la/ /lhung bzed chung ngu skyu ru ras bkang phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs mdzes par gshegasalgepa ded dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan lhun po la/ /seng ge'i gdan khri dag ni phul nas kyang | /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs bsod nams 'khor los sgyur7rgyal tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nga ro sbyangs pa la/ /rin po che las byas pa'i bla re phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs chos sgron gdugs ni tshongatshwanyepa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bsdu ba rnam 'byed la/ /lhung bzed rin po che dag phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs bkra shis ldan pa tshong dpon tshe//de bzhin gshegs pa gsal ba'i dpal de la/ /kun dga' ra ba dag ni phul 45—777

nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs yul 'khor mya ngan med pa po/ /tshong dpon bu tshe stan rings hu)phul nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba snang ba la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs blo gros sems dpa' tshonasakhyim bdag tshe/ /gnas dang zas kyi rkyen ris bcad nas kyang / /bde gshegs yon tan phung po 'od de la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo ldan 'ug pa'i tshe/ /gos dang shing leb dag ni bzhag tshinas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi stobs de la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs chos sgron spyan ni dbul po'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros ldan de la/ /rgya sran drus pa dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs shugs 'dor bu ram chang bumakhan tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam grags rgyal po la/ /bu ram shing gi bcud khu btung ba phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs stobs chen tshong pa'i chung ma'i tshe/ /phye khalas3)gsum ni gnyug mar bzhag nas kyang / /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po thul ba la/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs shes rab me tog —ded dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa stabs kyi 6)mchog ma de'i/ /lam srang spyidag ni phyag dar dun)byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs brtan pa'i dbyangs ni ded dpon tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi'i 'od zer la/ /gos kyi bla re 9tshodag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bde ldan smad 'tshong hu tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi sems pa la/ / shi yi bur 3nyam 45—778

dag ni phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa don gsung tshong pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs can rab mchog la/ / ka sha'i 3)gdan dag dbul ba byas nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs dgyesashosagasal grong rdal ba yi tshe /de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug phud dgyes de la/ /kha ra dag dang sbyar ba'i btung ba phul/ /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs seng ge'i zhal ni phreng rgyud tshe/ /bde gshegs kha dog zil gyis mi non la/ /me tog khal bcu dag gis gtor 5)nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do / /de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug phud shing srungs batshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gsal ba la/ /spos dang a mra'i 'bras bu phul nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa snang mdzad slong ba'i tshe//de bzhin gshegs pa bkodang5)pa'i rgyal po yi/ /bshos dag bdag nyid btsongs te sbyar nas kyang / /dang por byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /sangs rgyas stong gi sngon gyi smon lam gyi 57 tshul rdzogs ston)// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /de ltar sangs rgyas dag la chung ba yi9)/ /yon phul rnam par smin pa 'di dag yin/ /'khor tshe de yi 'bras bu de 'dra na/ /mkhas pa su zhig byang chub sems mi skyed/ no/ /nam mkha' dag ni 11tshad dag gzung 32ba dang / /rgya mtsho chen po mthar gyis bgrang nus kyi/ /sangs rgyas dag la dad pa shas tsam gyi/rte / /bsod nams tshad gzung tshabar ni nus par dka'/ /ji srid mya ngan 'das bde ma reg param/ /de srid mi khom sdug bsngal myong mi 'gyur/ /de 45—779

bas rgyal ba bsod nams zhing thob nas/ /bag yod mi yis bkur stetumachod pa gyis/ /sangs rgyas dag la lhag par mos pa'i tshe/ /bde gshegs mya ngan 'das pa'i sku gdung la/ /mchod pa chung shas7byed pa'i yon tan mtha'/ /bsam par nus ma yin na de lta zhog /byang chub sems kyis rgyal la7yon phul dang | /gang dag tshad med chos 'di bzhi po dang / /nam mkha'i khams dang sems can khams rnams dag /ston pa ma gtogs shes par nus pa med/ /gang phyir sems can thams cad rjes gzung0phyir/ /byang chub sems bskyed gnas pa ji lta bar/ /dbul pos dpag tshad khor yug gcig tsam gyi/ /gter dag rnyed pa de ltar dga' ma yin/ /sangs rgyas byang chub phyir ni rgyal bsheyi / /rnam par rol pa brgyad dang stobs bcu dang / /sems can sdud pa lnga brgya dga' mdzad bzhi/ /rtogs byed 'jug pa dag ni brgyad khri dang / /rtogs par dka' ba brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang / /bla na med pa'i sgo mo drug khri dang / /sa rnam7'byed dang ye shes bdun cu drug /sangs rgyas mtshon pa spyod pa bcwa brgyadasnyedang / /pha rol gnon pa lnga dang brtan pa bcu/ /spyod yul ther 'bum phrag ni bcu gcig dang / /gzhan yang sangs rgyas dag gi yon tan gang ske/ /mtshan dang dpe byad dag dang spyod lam dag /rang sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul lam min na/ /nyan thos sgra rjes 'brang ba'i smos ci dgos/ /mtshungs pa med pa 'dra ba yod min pas/ /des na sangs rgyas bsam mi khyab ces brjod/ /gang dag byang chub mchog rab sems yod pa/ /de dang de dag mi dman mtshungs med spyod/ /de dag de ring 'jig rten nor chen rnyed/ /de dag 'jig rten legs par 'tsho bas 'tsho/ /bdud rnams bcom ste bdud rtsi 45—780

reg byas nas/ /char sprin lhun sdug0)lta bur tshim par byed/ /gang de byang chub laltezhugs 'jig rten skyob/ /de dag nor bdun dag gis sdud parasabyed / /gal te sdug bsngal brgya mang bzod byed pa/ /de bas byang chub gang zhugs skyosemi 'gyur/ /de yis yon tan de dag myur 'thob la/ /'jig rten kun gyisamachog ma dag tu'ang 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i rgyu yis sdug bsngal mang po myong bar 'gyur/ /gang gi rnam par smin pasasnyingan 'gror lhung bar 'gyur/ /mtho ris 'gro dang byang chub yon tan don gyi phyir/ /mkhas pa su zhig byis pa dag dang7'gal bar byed/ /byis pa 'gal byed mkhas pa 'gal mi byed/ /mi shes 'khrul yin shes ldan dran pa thob/ /blun po 'dam bying mkhas pa thang la gnas/ /gang dag chos spyod pa ni de la bzod/ /de bas7rigs pa can min spang bya zhing / /gang dag shes yul rigs ldan bsten77par bya/ /dpal dang grags pa rnyed pa spangs nas kyang / /ting nge 'dzin 'di la ni rnal 'byor bya/ /sangs rgyas re re'i yon tan dran pa yang / /bskal pa khri phrag tshad med bzod byed5nyen/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bsam med smos ci dgos/ /de bas sdug bsngal nyam thag dang du long hurte/ /bzod dang ting 'dzin dag gi migo bgos la/ /brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan tshul7khrims shing rta zhon/ /sbyin stobs shes rab mda' yis bdud bcom ste/ /pham 7byas byang chub dag la reg par gyis/ /byams pa'i grogs dang bsgrub pa'i bshes gnyen dang / /dbyer med pha rol phyin pa spro byed dang / /stong pa'i gnas bcas shugs kyi zas sten tshe/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan thob par gyis/ /de bas ji skad 'dir gsungs rnam nges la/ /bag tsho/shedang ldan pas rtag tu sbyor 3)bar gyis/ /mkha' la ngang pa skad 45—781

'byin dga' ba ltar/ /thams cad mkhyen pa myur du thob par gyis/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus mtha' yas zhes bya ba 'khor ther 'bum snyed dang bcas pa zhig byung bar gyur te de ting nge 'dzin 'di ston to/ /de ting nge 'dzin 'di ston pa na de'i tshe rgyal po bsod nams me tog ces bya ba zhig ①byung bas thos nas/des btsun mo stong dang sras stong la smras pa/ ting nge 'dzin zad ④par snang ba 'di'i don risakyang mi shes so/ /ma shes pas rtogs par byar ④yang mi nus so/ /de lta rigeyin gyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pas legs par gsungs pa la bdag cag gis rjes su yi rangakhebar ni bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs shing bshad pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di spyil rjes su yi rang ba7byas pas/ de dag rjes su yi rang〈)ba'i mod la bskal 3 )pa brgyad khrir〈lha'akhor ba bsnyil nas de las〈nyekha phyir phyogs par gyur to/ /khyim can zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyang thob par gyur to / /byang chub ji skad bstan pa la yang the tshom hurtemed par gyur to/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba des na sangs rgyas sum 'bum dag mnyes 0par byas par mgyur to/ /thams cad du yang ting nge tshe'adzin 'di thob par gyur to/ /log par ltung ba dang ske/ mi khom pa dag tu nam yang ltung bar ma gyur to/ /rgyu de kho nas byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po khyod de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po bsod nams me tog ces bya ba de khyod kyis gzhan yin kyi no snyam pa de ltar blta bar mi bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med lha de'i tshe de'i dus na/ rgyal po bsod nams me tog ces bya bar gyur to/ /bskal pa bzang po pa'i de bzhin 45—782

gshegs pa de dag ni de'i tshe de'i dus na sras stong du gyur to/ /de ltar rjes su yi rang ba hu)tsam gyis kyang ting nge 'dzin 'di mthu che ba yin na klog pa dang /lung 'bogs〈bapa dang / bsgrub pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi dga' zhes bya ba 'khor ge'abum snyed la)dang bcas pa zhig byung bar gyur te/ de la 'khor los sgyuras3ba'i rgyal po blo yangs zhes bya bas khang bzangs gser gyi 'od dang ldan pa tsan dan dmar po'i chus btab pa/ a ga ri ru'i bdug rtsodapas bdugs pa zhig phul lo/ /longs spyad da pa'i phyir dge slong gi dge 'dun thams cad la yang de kho na dang 'dra ba zhig phul bar gyur to/ /de dag thams cad la yang skyed rtso)mos tshal re re yang phul bar gyur to/ /des tshabacom ldan 'das de77las ting nge 'dzin bstan pa 'di yang thos so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de nyid lho)kyi rim gro pa mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog /shes rab rdzogs zhes bya ba zhig byung bar gyur pa de la des 'di skad du/ 'di ltar bdag gis ting nge 'dzin 'di shes par bya na khyim na gnas pas ni 'di rtogs par dka' yis1snye/ci nas kyang bdag gis skra dang kha spu bregs la khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar bya sagor ma chag go zhes smras so/ /de nas skra dang kha spu bregs nas/gos ngur smrig bgos 7te/ khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas/ sras khri dang ske/ btsun mo brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag thams cad dang 7lhan cig tu rab tu byung ste/ ting nge 'dzin 'di'i rnam pa dag zhus 3 pa dang / bcom ldan 'das des de dag gi 12bsam pa thugs su chud nas/ ting nge 'dzin 'di zhag bdun gyi bar du rgya cher yang dag par bstan to/ /de dag gis thos nas 45—783

kyang ske/ gcig la gcig 'di skad du/ kye ma ting nge 'dzin 'di0mthong bar dka' mod kyi/ 'on kyang ting nge 'dzin 'di legs par bris te bcang bar bya'o zhes 'dzer to/ /de dag thams cad kyis7ting nge 'dzin 'di bris nas kyang mchod pa byas so/ /bzung ngo / /lung yang phog go/ /de nas de dag thams cad dus las 'das nas/ slar de dag tshogs par gyur pas sangs rgyas drug 'bum mnyes par byas par gyur to/ /thams cad du ting nge 'dzin 'di thos par gyur to/ /thams cadam norab tu byung nas/ ting nge 'dzin 'di thob par gyur to/ /smon lam ji ltar btab pa bzhin/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kho nas thams cad kyis byang chub rab tu thob par gyur to/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po khyod de'i tshe de'i dus na/ 'khor los sgyuram④ba'i rgyal po blo yangs de khyod kyis gzhan yin no snyam pa de ltar blta bar mi bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa mar me mdzad mede/ de'i tshe de'i dus na 'khor los sgyurarnyuba'i rgyal po blo yangs zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs de ni/ dge slong rim gro pa shes rab rdzogs zhes bya bar gyur to/ /gang dgashesras khri po de dag ni bskal pa 'di nas bzungs 8)ste/ bskal pa drug cu rtsa lnga'i bar du 'tshang rgya bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu bskal pa grags pa chen po zhes bya ba zhig 'byungamo'ibar 'gyur 7te/ bskal pa gcig po de la de dag byang chub mngon par〈sperdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /gang dag blon po brgyad khri po de dag ni/bskal pa grags pa chen po 'das nas/ bskal pa brgyad cu'i bar du 'tshang rgya bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu bskal pa skar ma lta bu zhes bya ba zhig 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de la blon po brgyad khri po de dag byang chub mngon par rdzogs 45—784

par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa skar ma lta bu 'das nas/ bskal pa sum brgya ni0)sangs rgyas 'byung bar mi la'agyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu bskal pa yon tan bkod pa zhes bya ba zhig 'byung bar 'gyur phro/ /de la btsun mo brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di ni de ltar 'bras bu che ba yin no/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa'i ④lhag pa'i bsam pa rdzogs pa/ lus dang srog la mi lta bar gyur pas/ ting nge 'dzin 'di btsal bar bya'o/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas/ting nge 'dzin 'di la rnal 'byor du bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /sangs rgyas byang chub don du gnyer ba gang / /de dag rgyal po de yi rjes su slob/ /yang dag bsgrub lasnyiganas pa ma gtogs par/ /gzhan gyis byang chub mchog ni〈pe'athob mi 'gyur/ /de ltar 'dirasheni dad pa chung bskyed kyang / /de bzhin rnam smin gya rnam 'thobashepar 'gyur/ /de bas g.yo med lhag pa'i bsam pa yis/ /'dir ni ci rigs bkur stes7rnal 'byor gyis/ /rgyal badz+wa rigang de bdag gis 'dir bsgrags pa/ /de dag gang zhig mthong bar 'dod pa dang / /bstan pa rgya cher 'chad par 'dod pa dag /ji5rnyeskad bstan bzhin 'di la rnal 'byor gyis/ /yi rang nyid kyis phun sum tshogs 'gyur na/ /'chang dang klog pa lta zhig ci smos te/ /yon tan mtha' ni 'gro bas bsam mi nus/ /'di thos su zhig rnal 'byor sbyor mi byed / /byang chub so so yang dag rig mtshan dang / /ston dang pha rol sems ni 45—785

gleng ba dang / /sgrub dang snang ba gang dag sangs rgyas chos/ /ting nge 'dzin 'di las ni btsal bar bya/ /las sbyong ①de bzhin bdud rnams 'jomasalgepa dang ske/ /lta sbyong de bzhin srid sapa zad byed dang / /rnam par rol dang zhing bkod 'byor pa dag /'di dang rab tu ldan la dkon ma yin/ /de bzhin rnam grol spobs pa phun tshogs dang lta/ /bya ba thams cad sbyong byed gzugs59dag dang / /bsam pa ji bzhin mabyang chub 'tshang rgya ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir gnas mod pa yin/ /nga yis de snyed tshig gis rjod ⑧/nus rnams/ /de lta bas na de dag 'dir sgrubs 9)shig /kun mkhyen chos la dga' bar ma byas na / /phyi dus dag na 'gyod par gyur nyu )ta re/ /pha rol phyin pa ji snyed ngas bstan dang / /gang dag ye shes rgya mtsho sbyor lam dag /lus rten byis pa'i spyod la gnas pa yisahunya/ /shes par bya ba dag hu tu nus ma yin/ /dus ngan pa dang sems can ma rungs dang / /chos nub mtha' dang ngan song 'phel ba na/ /mkhas pas shin tu yid byung byas nas 1 kyang / /bag yod ri dgas bzhin du skrag par 'gyur/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig gis bskal pa stong du thabs mkhas pa ma gtogs par/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dag la spyad pa bas beni/ ting nge 'dzin 'di thos nas rjes su yi rang bar byas pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po 'di la8/ bsod nams kyi phung po snga ma des brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro ba nas/ dpe'i bar du yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /chos kyi sarnam grangs 'di bstan pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed denyi rme/de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi 45—786

ldog par gyur to(1sku/ /lha dang mi'i skye dgu'i 35tshogs brgyad 'bum snyed kyang /rdul med cing dri ma dang bral la chos rnams la chos kyi mig rnam par dag go/ /lha de dag chos kyi mig rnam par dag pas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos la mngon par dga' me ba'i phyir stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i la'ajig rten gyi khams dag me tog gis chal par bkram par gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos so/ /bar snang las kyang lha'i rnga sgra dag bsgrags so/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bye ba snyed thams cad kyis kyang ting nge 'dzin 'di thob bo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad dang / lha dang / mi dang ske/ lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la yi rangs te pa mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa bskal pa bzang po pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs stotsun // //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bit+yā ka ra sing ha dang / lots+tsha mab ban de 8dpal gyi dbyangs kyis bsgyurage/ zhu chen gyi lots+tsha 7ba ban de 11dpal brtsegs kyis zhus te gtan la phab pa12 15 ngashu bha mastu sarba dza ga t+t+waṃ// //boye dharmā bohe tu pra bha wā 16he durnye 1 ṣān ta thā ga to h+ya ba data18/ te ṣāñtsa 3tsheyo ni ro dha e wī bā 3 )dri ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ21/ me ga lo bha bskyon // //ma snye45—787
